title: wolfssl_ecdh_agree: no upper bound on okm_len before passing to wc_HKDF
description: wolfssl_ecdh_agree validates okm_len != 0 but does not check okm_len <= CRYPTO2DEV_AGREE_OKM_MAXLEN. wc_HKDF with WC_SHA256 supports at most 255*32=8160 bytes (RFC 5869 §2.3). If okm_len exceeds that, wc_HKDF returns an error after potentially running ECDH. More importantly, okm points to a struct field in a copy of the UAPI struct (size is bounded by struct layout), but the provider should not assume framework-level validation was done. Add check: if (okm_len > CRYPTO2DEV_AGREE_OKM_MAXLEN) return -EINVAL.
